mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as recession fears mount.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime characterized by negative industrial production growth, a decline in industrial output (INDPRO) signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth is negative and the regime_hint condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates a demand shock where consumer spending weakens while inflation rises, reducing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2.0 percentage points over a three-month period signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate investment expectations weaken.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 2.0% in 3 months.
